commit.message:
fix(macos): use data protection keychain to stop repeated keychain prompts (#4574)

Removes the explicit `useDataProtectionKeyChain: false` override on
MacOsOptions. The flutter_secure_storage default is now `true`, which
uses the modern data protection keychain. Items are scoped to the
`keychain-access-groups` entitlement (already configured) instead of
the binary's code signature, so rebuilds no longer trigger the "enter
your login keychain password" prompt for every stored item.

Tradeoff: existing macOS users have credentials in the legacy login
keychain; after this change the app reads the data protection keychain
and won't see them, so they'll need to sign in again. iOS, Android,
and Linux are unaffected.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
fix(audio): route extracted audio paths to AudioSourceConfig.file (#4395) (#4549)

* fix(audio): route extracted audio paths to AudioSourceConfig.file (#4395)

Crashlytics issue e81e2bc1d6713fa5d91e7b15a0950e18: extracted audio paths (bare absolute paths produced by clip_editor_bloc via extractAudio(videoPath)) were classified as .network in AudioTimingCubit and passed to HttpClient.getUrl, crashing with 'No host specified in URI'.

Fix:
- AudioTimingCubit: three-way classification in _setClippedAudioSource:
  bundled -> AudioSourceConfig.asset
  file:// URI or bare absolute path (starts with '/') -> AudioSourceConfig.file (with Uri.toFilePath decoding)
  otherwise -> AudioSourceConfig.network
- AudioClipPlayer: defense-in-depth guard in _defaultRemoteAudioFileLoader throws ArgumentError for non-http(s) schemes.

Tests:
- 4 new blocTests in audio_timing_cubit_test.dart (bare path, file://, https, bundled).
- 2 new tests in audio_clip_player_test.dart (guard throws, file source skips remote loader).

* refactor(audio): extract _configForUrl helper; note content:// and blob: in guard comment

- Extract inline URL classification logic in AudioTimingCubit into a
  private static _configForUrl helper (cleaner _setClippedAudioSource).
- Add a note to the ArgumentError guard in AudioClipPlayer that
  platform-specific schemes (Android content://, web blob:) are also
  rejected, not just bare paths and file:// URIs.

refactor(providers): split repository providers out of app_providers.dart (#4555)

* refactor(providers): split repository providers out of app_providers.dart

Second sub-batch (9b of 3) of #4506's final wave. Refs #4339 Wave 2.

Moves the 14-entity repository cluster to lib/providers/repository_providers.dart:

- badgeRepositoryProvider (legacy Provider<X>)
- cachedFollowingList + followRepository (follow cluster)
- profileRepository, categoriesRepository, hashtagRepository
- curatedListRepository + CuratedListsState (notifier) + curationRepository
- peopleListsRepository (+ private _peopleListsBoxName const)
- bookmarkService, muteService (NIP-51 services with repository shape)
- dmRepository (NIP-17 DM persistence)
- commentsRepository (NIP-22 comments)

Migration pattern (mirrors batches 5-9a):

  // app_providers.dart
  import 'package:openvine/providers/repository_providers.dart';
  // ...
  export 'repository_providers.dart';

- Back-import keeps createBlockedAuthorFilter + pendingActionServiceProvider
  (both stay in app_providers.dart until 9c) resolvable from the new file.
- Export keeps existing consumers' imports unchanged.

Scope cleanup:

- dart fix --apply removed 23 newly-unused imports from app_providers.dart.
- Three dead-code marker comments deleted: VideoManagerService removed,
  Legacy ExploreVideoManager removed, "In app_providers.dart" stub.
- Four workspace package dependencies surfaced as direct deps in pubspec.yaml
  (comments_repository, curated_list_repository, profile_repository, models),
  added bare in the workspace-deps section to match existing convention.

Cumulative reduction: app_providers.dart 978 -> 455 LoC (84% reduction from
the original 2,918). One sub-batch remains (9c: social + foundation) to
fully exhaust #4506.

Test plan:
- dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs (clean)
- flutter analyze lib test integration_test (no issues)
- flutter test test/screens/feed/pooled_video_feed_item_repo_swap_test.dart

  test/providers/individual_video_providers_test.dart
  test/providers/dm_repository_provider_test.dart
  test/screens/comments/comments_header_test.dart (16 passed)

* refactor(providers): mark temporary provider shims

* build(providers): refresh generated hashes

Flutter 3.44 analyzer fails to infer the 4-parameter VideoBuilder

body forces the analyzer to use the contextual VideoBuilder type.

commit.message:
refactor(async): use .timeout() in BackgroundActivityManager (#4517) (#4553)

* refactor(async): use .timeout() in BackgroundActivityManager (#4517)

Replace the hand-rolled `Future.any([Future(fn), Future.delayed(...)])`
timeout in `_performImmediateBackgroundActions` with the proper
`.timeout()` API so the grace period emits a real `TimeoutException`
we can log distinctly from other suspend failures, instead of racing a
silent `Future.delayed` and swallowing the bound.

Extracts the 1s suspend window into `_suspendGracePeriod` so the
intent is named at the field declaration rather than buried in the
loop body.

Adds a regression test that asserts the manager isolates a throwing
service so siblings in the same suspend pass still get notified —
that's the coordination this loop has always promised, and the
existing single-service test didn't cover the cross-service failure
isolation path.

Note on the timeout path itself: `BackgroundAwareService.onAppBackgrounded`
returns `void`, so `Future(voidFn)` always completes in a single
microtask and `.timeout()` cannot fire today. The defense remains in
case the interface is ever widened to `FutureOr<void>`; explicitly
testing the bound is out of scope here and would require a separate
interface change.

Drops one of the 18 production `Future.delayed` call sites tracked in
#4517 (now 17).

* review: be honest about the timeout's reach + readable duration log

Self-review of #4553 surfaced two issues:

1. The inline comment claimed the timeout "bounds *our* wait" while the
   service call "continues to run in the background" — true only if a
   service uses `unawaited()` or returns a Future. Both current
   in-tree implementations (AuthService, AnalyticsService) are
   synchronous `void`, so nothing continues. The comment overstated
   what the code does today.

2. The TimeoutException log interpolated `$_suspendGracePeriod`,
   which renders as `0:00:01.000000` (Duration.toString). Switched to
   `${_suspendGracePeriod.inSeconds}s` for a readable warning.

Also re-anchored the `_suspendGracePeriod` doc comment so the
defensive-future-proofing intent is explicit at the field declaration
rather than implied at the call site. No behavior change.

* test(background): isolate singleton state in manager tests

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
refactor(providers): split upload & media providers out of app_providers.dart (#4550)

First sub-batch of #4506's final wave (9a of 9c). Moves the 10-entity
upload/media cluster to `lib/providers/upload_media_providers.dart`:

Auth/media chain (preserved through batches 5 and 7):
- _BlossomAuthAdapter (private adapter for BlossomAuthProvider)
- _FirebasePerformanceAdapter (private adapter for BlossomPerformanceMonitor)
- blossomAuthService
- mediaViewerAuthServiceProvider (legacy `Provider<X>(...)` style)
- mediaAuthInterceptor

Upload chain:
- blossomUploadService
- uploadManager (top of upload chain — many UI consumers)

API + audio:
- apiService (nip98-backed)
- crosspostApiClient (Bluesky-toggle settings)
- audioPlaybackService

`app_providers.dart` adds `import 'upload_media_providers.dart';`
(back-import — `bugReportService` consumes `blossomUploadServiceProvider`)
and `export 'upload_media_providers.dart';` (keeps 28 external consumer
imports unchanged).

No mutual import with `app_providers.dart` from the new file — all
outbound deps reach already-split files: `auth_providers.dart`
(authService, oauthClient, oauthConfig, nip98AuthService),
`moderation_providers.dart` (ageVerificationService, contentFilterService),
`environment_provider.dart` (currentEnvironmentProvider).

Discovered + fixed during implementation:
- AudioPlaybackService lives in the `sound_service` package, not
  `openvine/services/audio_playback_service.dart` (path that didn't
  exist) — corrected the import.

Removed 9 now-unused imports from `app_providers.dart` via `dart fix`:
blossom_upload_service, api_service, auth_service (no longer needed),
crosspost_api_client, media_auth_interceptor, etc.

Codegen moved: 6 *Provider chunks (~378 LoC) relocated from
`app_providers.g.dart` into `upload_media_providers.g.dart`.

This is the cleanest cluster of the wave — no in-line state machines,
no bridges, no dead providers, no log-level mismatches. Pure
dependency injection.

After this batch, `app_providers.dart` is 1120 → 978 LoC. Two
sub-batches remain (9b: Repositories, 9c: Social + foundation).

Refs #4506, #4339 Wave 2
